blocked_requirements.reason: No authorized physical multiview capture of a remote body has been supplied to this repository. A synthetic remote body would silently change the claim from OBSERVED to PROCEDURAL_GROUND_TRUTH and is therefore refused for this target.
blocked_requirements.required_to_unblock: ≥24 rights-cleared consumer multiview images of a real remote body, EXIF/capture receipt, approximate scale anchor (MEASURED or MANUFACTURER_SPEC), and an explicit rights_state of OWNED or LICENSED. Dense COLMAP MVS remains separately blocked without CUDA.

blocked_requirements.reason: Host COLMAP is 4.0.4 without CUDA. Sparse SfM can run when images exist; dense MVS cannot and must be reported blocked, never faked.
blocked_requirements.required_to_unblock: CUDA-capable COLMAP dense MVS build, or an alternative dense backend with a measured accuracy receipt on this target.

limitations: Filesystem digests bind committed trees only.
